description: A small round zen garden tray filled with white sand sits on the table, with a tiny pagoda and a small seated figure inside it, and a yellow rake is being used to make patterns. The left hand rests near the tray while the right hand, as a right-hand object, presses the yellow rake into the sand and drags it in short strokes, moving from the lower right area toward the figurine and then across toward the pagoda to smooth and reshape the ripples.
